note: Closed variety of the tracker's bug tickets (AR-1, FR-13): bug_records.open_source_bugs lists a source ticket as an OPEN bug when its `type` is one of `bug_types` and its `status` is none of `closed_statuses` (both compared case-folded, whole text). A status this list does not name is read as open: a duplicate hint may be shown for a ticket that is in fact closed, and the person decides (the hint never files or drops anything). A project whose tracker uses other words extends these lists.
